**Path summary:** `useInfiniteMemos` (also `useMemos` in the same file) calls `memoServiceClient.listMemos` from `web/src/connect.ts`, which invokes the `ListMemos` RPC on `MemoService` defined in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`. The backend handler `ListMemos` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls `s.Store.ListMemos` in `store/memo.go`, which delegates to a dialect driver such as `ListMemos` in `store/db/postgres/memo.go` (MySQL and SQLite equivalents live in `store/db/mysql/memo.go` and `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`).
